rationale: The description only identifies a software-development company and says its tools target developers and project managers; it does not state what the tools do, so a conventional offering cannot be established with confidence.
evidence_spans: tools are targeted towards software developers and project managers
conflict_response: The concern is valid: company category and intended audience do not establish the tools' actual functions. Without importing product knowledge, the best binary judgment remains a weak, forced non-AI rather than treating the audience description as substantive conventional functionality.
